Engine and transmission repair in Bukit Indah

Misfires, vibration, a new noise or a gearbox that shifts badly. Tell us what the car is doing and we will start with a scan and a look.

Engine work

Our bay sees engine jobs on cars from small Hondas to BMW and Mercedes-Benz. Ignition coils, mounts, belts and gaskets are among the parts laid out on the floor in our workshop photos.

Transmission service

If the gearbox slips, jerks or shifts late, WhatsApp us the model, year and what you feel when it happens.

Questions drivers ask

My engine light is on. What first?

Start with a computer scan. It reads the fault codes so we can see where to look.

Can you repair Continental cars?

Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Mini, Land Rover and Volkswagen are among the makes seen in our bay. Send your model and year to check.
